name: @cinatra-ai/extension-authoring-skill
description: The Cinatra chat assistant's extension-package authoring methodology — one router bundle carrying the kind-agnostic spine (kind selection, trust/confirmation flow, validator contract, six-stage package lifecycle) with per-kind references for agent, workflow, artifact and skill packages. Consolidated from the five extension-authoring bundles of @cinatra-ai/assistant-skills (cinatra#2090).
